scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix frontend && uv --directory fraud-service sync
scripts.start:local: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "backend,fraud-service,shap,frontend" -c "blue,magenta,yellow,cyan" "cd backend && mvnw spring-boot:run" "cd fraud-service && uv run uvicorn main:app" "cd fraud-service && uv run python shap_worker.py" "cd frontend && npm start"
